name: Electric air taxis (eVTOL)
title: Electric air taxis after Lilium and Volocopter: the board abstains
question: Are electric air taxis viable after Lilium and Volocopter failed?
answer: The FAA finished its rules for powered-lift aircraft and pilots in late 2024, the regulatory piece air taxis had waited for. Within months Lilium entered insolvency and Volocopter filed for insolvency in December 2024. When the named blocker crosses and leading companies still fail, it was not the binding constraint; battery energy and certification cost are likelier, and the board abstains.
verdict_reason: The regulatory blocker crossed and leaders still failed, so the rule abstains.

constraint.name: Powered-lift rules (named, but not binding)
constraint.detail: The FAA powered-lift framework crossed in 2024; certification cost and battery energy density did not visibly move.

graveyard.name: Lilium
graveyard.how: Insolvency proceedings, late 2024 and again in 2025

graveyard.name: Volocopter
graveyard.how: Filed for insolvency, December 2024; assets sold in 2025
